allow: PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File -Path src, public -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch 'node_modules' } | ForEach-Object { "{0}`t{1}" -f $_.Length, \($_.FullName.Replace\(\(Get-Location\).Path + '\\',''\)\) }; Get-ChildItem -File | Select-Object Name, Length)

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Recurse src\\routes -File | Where-Object Name -ne '__root.tsx' | Where-Object Name -ne 'financeiro.tsx' | ForEach-Object { "=== " + $_.FullName.Replace\(\(Get-Location\).Path + '\\',''\); Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw -Encoding utf8 })
